question: How many districts of West Bengal were included in the 'Combating Child Trafficking' campaign in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In August 2022, **11 districts** of West Bengal were included in the 'Combating Child Trafficking' campaign.
 
• These district**s were chosen based on their higher prevalence of child trafficking cases and other socio-economic factors that contributed to the vulnerabilit**y of children to trafficking.
 
• The campaign was a collaborative effort involving multiple stakeholders, including government agencies, NGOs, and law enforcement, to strengthen child protection measures and ensure the safety and well-being of children.
 
• The 'Combating Child Trafficking' campaign in West Bengal, launched in August 2022,
 
• It aimed at addressing and preventing child trafficking in specific vulnerable districts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **The 11 districts included were:**

 
• South 24 Parganas
 
• East Midnapore
 
• West Midnapore
 
• North 24 Parganas
 
• Cooch Behar
 
• Darjeeling
 
• Jalpaiguri
 
• Malda
 
• Murshidabad
 
• Birbhum
 
• Bankura

These districts were targeted to implement strategies like community engagement, better surveillance, legal interventions, and coordination among different stakeholders to combat child trafficking effectively.
